name: Office
description: Read, create and edit Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files with bounded local tools.

skills.name: office_read
skills.description: Inspect Office/PDF files, paginate content, preserve formulas and identify scanned pages.

skills.name: office_write
skills.description: Create editable Office files; make controlled copies and preserve styles.

skills.name: office_spec
skills.description: Exact JSON schemas, examples, limits and failure semantics for the pack tools.

skills.name: office_render
skills.description: Render PDF pages for visual QA without Office or browser dependencies.

skills.name: office_convert
skills.description: Optional LibreOffice conversion for legacy formats, recalculation and visual inspection.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Read bounded paragraphs, worksheet cells, slide text/notes or PDF pages/forms. Indexes are zero-based except Excel coordinates.

path.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

data_only.description: Read cached Excel values; never computes formulas.

tools.name: compose
tools.description: Create a new docx/xlsx/pptx/pdf from a workspace JSON spec. See skill for spec contract. Large content belongs in spec files.

spec.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

output.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit a copy: DOCX/PPTX style-preserving replacements, or XLSX cell updates. Source remains unchanged.

path.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

spec.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

output.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

tools.name: pdf_modify
tools.description: Merge/select/rotate PDF pages or fill existing form fields. Page indexes are zero-based; output is not flattened.

items.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

output.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

tools.name: render
tools.description: Render one zero-based PDF page to PNG through PDFium. Check glyphs/layout before delivery.

path.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

output.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert legacy/modern Office input through separately installed, host-bound LibreOffice. Conversion is optional and may change layout.

path.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

output.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

FILE_ROOT.title: Thư mục làm việc
FILE_ROOT.description: Thư mục làm việc của cuộc trò chuyện. Nest cấp tự động; công cụ chỉ đọc và ghi tệp trong thư mục này.

PYTHON_EXECUTABLE.title: Python của máy chủ
PYTHON_EXECUTABLE.description: Đường dẫn tuyệt đối tới trình Python đã cài sẵn thư viện của pack (xem README). Máy chủ đặt biến môi trường SOOT_MEDIA_PYTHON.

OFFICE_BINDING.title: Bộ chuyển đổi Office
OFFICE_BINDING.description: JSON trỏ tới LibreOffice của máy chủ, chỉ cần để chuyển đổi định dạng. Máy chủ đặt biến môi trường SOOT_OFFICE_BINDING.
